name: infino_list_tables
description: List the tables in the connected catalog. Call this first to discover what is available to search or query.

name: infino_describe_table
description: Return a table's column names and types, so you know which column to target and what fields each result row carries.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table name (from infino_list_tables).

name: infino_create_database
description: Provision the database named in the connection. On Infino Cloud this registers the database; on a local path or bucket it is a no-op success. Idempotent.

name: infino_create_table
description: Create a table from a {column: type} descriptor, with full-text (BM25) indexes and, with vector: true, an embedding column sized to the server's embedder and a cosine vector index.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table name.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: Columns as {name: type}: utf8, large_utf8, bool, int32, int64, float32, float64. large_utf8 for text to search; utf8 for a key, ids, and short labels.

arguments.name: fts
arguments.desc: Columns to full-text index. Default: every large_utf8 column.

arguments.name: vector
arguments.desc: Add an 'embedding' vector column sized to the server's embedder, with a cosine index. Default false.

name: infino_drop_table
description: Drop a table from the catalog and, by default, delete its storage objects too. Irreversible.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to drop.

arguments.name: purge
arguments.desc: Also delete the table's storage objects. Default true; false only unregisters the name.

name: infino_semantic_search
description: Find rows by meaning: embeds the query with a local model (no API key) and ranks the table's embedding column by vector similarity. The score is a distance (lower is closer). An optional keyword pre-filter restricts the ranking.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to search.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Query text; embedded and matched by vector similarity.

arguments.name: k
arguments.desc: Maximum results (default 10, at most 100).

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Text column to return with each hit; inferred if omitted.

arguments.name: vectorColumn
arguments.desc: Vector column to search; inferred if omitted.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: Columns each hit returns, with full values. Defaults to the text column; _id and score are always included.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.desc: Pre-filter {column, query, mode?}: rank only among rows whose full-text column matches the query.

name: infino_keyword_search
description: BM25 full-text search for literal terms: identifiers, error codes, product names, exact phrases. The score is a relevance (higher is better).

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to search.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Query terms, matched as literal tokens.

arguments.name: k
arguments.desc: Maximum results to return (default 10, at most 100).

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Text column to search; inferred from the table schema when omitted.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Match any query token ('or', the default) or require every token ('and').

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: Columns each hit returns, with full values. Defaults to the searched column; _id and score are always included.

name: infino_hybrid_search
description: Fused keyword and semantic search in one ranking pass: BM25 over a text column combined with vector similarity, so rows matching the literal terms and the meaning rank highest.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to search.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Query text; matched as keyword terms and embedded for vector similarity.

arguments.name: k
arguments.desc: Maximum results (default 10, at most 100).

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Text column for the keyword half; inferred if omitted.

arguments.name: vectorColumn
arguments.desc: Vector column for the semantic half; inferred if omitted.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Keyword half: match any query token ('or', the default) or require every token ('and').

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: Columns each hit returns, with full values. Defaults to the text column; _id and score are always included.

name: infino_token_match
description: Unranked keyword filter: the set of rows whose text column contains the token(s).

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to search.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Token(s) to match.

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Text column to match; inferred if omitted.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Match any token ('or', the default) or every token ('and').

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max rows to return (default 100, at most 1000).

name: infino_exact_match
description: Unranked exact-equality filter over an indexed column: fetch rows whose column equals a tag, status, or id string.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to search.

arguments.name: value
arguments.desc: The exact value the column must equal.

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Column to match; inferred (first text column) if omitted.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max rows to return (default 100, at most 1000).

name: infino_count
description: Count how many rows match a keyword query, without fetching or ranking them.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to search.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Query terms, matched as literal tokens.

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Text column to search; inferred from the table schema when omitted.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Match any token ('or', the default) or every token ('and').

name: infino_sql
description: SQL for counts, filters, joins, and aggregates. The engine's search functions (bm25_search, vector_search, hybrid_search, token_match, exact_match) are callable as table-valued relations, so one query can rank and aggregate. Any single statement, DDL and DML included.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: A single SQL statement. May use search table functions and {{name}} vector placeholders.

arguments.name: embed
arguments.desc: Map of placeholder name to query text; each text is embedded and its vector substituted for {{name}} in the query.

name: infino_add_documents
description: Append rows (JSON objects keyed by column name) to a table in one commit. Rows without a vector are embedded from the text column.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to append to.

arguments.name: documents
arguments.desc: Rows to append, as JSON objects keyed by column name.

name: infino_update_documents
description: Replace the rows matching a SQL predicate with new documents, 1:1. Missing vectors are embedded. Requires durable storage.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to update.

arguments.name: predicate
arguments.desc: SQL predicate selecting the rows to replace, e.g. "key = 'doc-1'".

arguments.name: documents
arguments.desc: Replacement rows; their count must equal the number of matched rows.

name: infino_delete_documents
description: Delete the rows matching a SQL predicate. Requires durable storage.

arguments.name: table
arguments.desc: Table to delete from.

arguments.name: predicate
arguments.desc: SQL predicate selecting the rows to delete, e.g. "status = 'spam'".
